story: This painting by John Philip Simpson is both a powerful abolitionist statement and a striking portrait of the celebrated Shakespearean actor Ira Aldridge. A freeborn American, Aldridge became the first Black man to play Othello on the London stage in 1833.

title: The Prairie on Fire

rights.attribution: Art Institute of Chicago — CC0 Public Domain Designation

story: Alvan Fisher was a pioneering American landscapist whose work offered a precedent for the Hudson River School. As a Romantic-era artist, Fisher preferred dramatic episodes, which involved striking contrasts between light and dark.
